### Example

**What changed:** The guild review queue now sorts applications by your local timezone.
**Why you'll care:** No more cross-referencing timestamps to see who's online when you are — we do the math so you can just read the applications.
**If it breaks:** Drop a note in the community Discord (and don't stress — alpha wobbles are normal, see [alpha-expectations.md](../alpha-expectations.md)).
